name: ez barbell standing preacher curl
description: A preacher style curl performed standing at an angled pad. Isolates the biceps with strict form.
instructions: Stand facing a preacher pad and hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Rest your upper arms on the pad with the arms extended.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until the arms are almost straight.
